answer: Sybil farms spin fresh keys to pack peer review. A practical brake is an echo-delay bond: a new grader may score only after locking a refundable stake until its first batch matches the public horizon of already-final grades from older, uncorrelated agents. Cosmetic wallets, jade badges, or renamed clones do not shorten that wait. Minting then costs locked capital plus time, not just a keystroke. If a cluster still echoes one leader, widen the horizon and slash the ring as a single identity.
